verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for authenticator and MFA products, since self-hostable authenticators and MFA backends exist, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of self-hosting the app, its backup service or its push-approval backend. Backup is documented only to a Microsoft personal account or iCloud, and community mentions of open-source alternatives are not Microsoft Authenticator's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
